name: Griseofulvin

fda.text: Prophylactic Usage Safety and efficacy of griseofulvin for prophylaxis of fungal infections have not been established. Serious Skin Reactions Severe skin reactions (e.g. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) and erythema multiforme have been reported with griseofulvin use. These reactions may be…

summary: This drug has warnings for severe skin reactions, including serious conditions like Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis, and erythema multiforme [3]. The safety and effectiveness of using griseofulvin to prevent fungal infections have not been proven [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a low score of 48 for liver concerns and a low score of 37 for heart concerns [M].
